questions.text: What is the English expression for "petak umpet"?
questions.discussion: Hide and seek is a game in which one player closes their eyes and looks for the others who hide.

audio.text: What is the English expression for "petak umpet"?

questions.text:
Read the clue: One player closes their eyes and counts while the others hide behind trees. Then the player looks for them.

Complete the sentence: After school, we play ___.
questions.discussion: One player looks for the others who are hiding. These actions describe hide and seek.

audio.text:
Read the clue: One player closes their eyes and counts while the others hide behind trees. Then the player looks for them.

Complete the sentence: After school, we play blank.

questions.text:
Read or listen to the clue: After school, one friend closes their eyes and counts while the others hide. Then that friend looks for them.

Which sentence names the game in the clue?
options: We play hide and seek after school.
We draw a hopscotch court before playing.
In jump rope, one or more players jump over a swinging rope.
In blindfold tag, one player wears a blindfold and tries to catch another player.
questions.answer: We play hide and seek after school.
questions.discussion: Closing the eyes while others hide, then looking for them, describes hide and seek. The clue also says that the children play after school.

audio.text:
Read or listen to the clue: After school, one friend closes their eyes and counts while the others hide. Then that friend looks for them.

Which sentence names the game in the clue?

questions.text: Which game uses hiding and seeking as its main actions?
questions.discussion: The description gives the main rule of the game. Match the action and equipment with the game name.

audio.text: Which game uses hiding and seeking as its main actions?

questions.text:
After school, your friends hide behind trees while you close your eyes and count. You then look for them.

Which sentence names the game you are playing?
options: We play hide and seek after school.
In tag, one player chases and tries to touch another player.
Jump means to move off the ground using your legs.
In blindfold tag, one player wears a blindfold and tries to catch another player.
questions.answer: We play hide and seek after school.
questions.discussion: The children hide and one player looks for them. This is hide and seek, and the text says they play after school.

audio.text:
After school, your friends hide behind trees while you close your eyes and count. You then look for them.

Which sentence names the game you are playing?

questions.text: What is the English expression for "engklek"?
questions.discussion: Hopscotch uses a court of squares. Players hop from one square to another.

audio.text: What is the English expression for "engklek"?

questions.text: Complete the sentence: We draw squares on the ground to play ___.
questions.discussion: Hopscotch uses a court of squares. Players hop from one square to another.

questions.text:
Read the clue: The children want to play a game in which they hop through numbered squares on the ground. They need to prepare the playing area first.

Which sentence describes the preparation for this game?
options: We draw a hopscotch court before playing.
In jump rope, one or more players jump over a swinging rope.
In blindfold tag, one player wears a blindfold and tries to catch another player.
In tag, one player chases and tries to touch another player.
questions.answer: We draw a hopscotch court before playing.
questions.discussion: A game played by hopping through numbered squares is hopscotch. Drawing the hopscotch court prepares the playing area.

questions.text: Which game uses a court of squares and a small token?
questions.discussion: Hopscotch uses a court with squares and a token. Players throw the token and hop through the squares.

questions.text:
Look at the game chart. The green box names the game you want to play.

Which sentence describes how to prepare the playing area for that game?
options: We draw a hopscotch court before playing.
Jump means to move off the ground using your legs.
In tag, one player chases and tries to touch another player.
Hop means to move by jumping on one foot.
questions.answer: We draw a hopscotch court before playing.
questions.discussion: The green box says Hopscotch. Drawing a hopscotch court prepares the playing area for that game.

questions.text: What is the English expression for "lompat tali"?
questions.discussion: Jump rope needs a rope. Players jump over it while others swing it.

questions.text: Complete the sentence: Two friends swing a rope while another friend plays ___.
questions.discussion: Jump rope needs a rope. Players jump over it while others swing it.

questions.text:
Read the clue: Two children turn a rope while another child jumps over it.

Which sentence names the game and explains what the jumping player does?
options: In jump rope, one or more players jump over a swinging rope.
In tag, one player chases and tries to touch another player.
Jump means to move off the ground using your legs.
In blindfold tag, one player wears a blindfold and tries to catch another player.
questions.answer: In jump rope, one or more players jump over a swinging rope.
questions.discussion: The clue describes jumping over a moving rope. The sentence about jump rope both names the game and explains the player's action.

questions.text: Which game needs a rope that swings above the ground?
questions.discussion: Jump rope uses a rope. One or more players jump while another person swings the rope.

questions.text:
Two friends swing a rope while you jump over it.

Which sentence names the game and explains what the jumping player does?
options: Jump means to move off the ground using your legs.
In jump rope, one or more players jump over a swinging rope.
Hop means to move by jumping on one foot.
The children swing the rope for the player.
questions.answer: In jump rope, one or more players jump over a swinging rope.
questions.discussion: The sentence beginning 'In jump rope' names the game and explains jumping over the rope. The other sentences describe only a movement or the helpers' action.

questions.text: What is the English expression for "permainan kejar-kejaran dengan mata tertutup"?
questions.discussion: Blindfold tag includes a blindfold. The player cannot see while trying to catch someone.

questions.text: Complete the sentence: One player wears a blindfold in ___.
questions.discussion: Blindfold tag includes a blindfold. The player cannot see while trying to catch someone.

questions.text:
Read the clue: One player has a cloth covering their eyes and tries to catch another player.

Which sentence names and describes this game?
options: We play hide and seek after school.
In blindfold tag, one player wears a blindfold and tries to catch another player.
We draw a hopscotch court before playing.
In jump rope, one or more players jump over a swinging rope.
questions.answer: In blindfold tag, one player wears a blindfold and tries to catch another player.
questions.discussion: The cloth is a blindfold. Trying to catch another player while wearing it describes blindfold tag.

questions.text: In which game does a blindfolded player try to tag others?
questions.discussion: Blindfold tag includes a blindfold. A player tries to catch or tag another player while unable to see clearly.

questions.text: A player wears a blindfold during the game. Which sentence explains the activity?
options: We play hide and seek after school.
In blindfold tag, one player wears a blindfold and tries to catch another player.
We draw a hopscotch court before playing.
In jump rope, one or more players jump over a swinging rope.
questions.answer: In blindfold tag, one player wears a blindfold and tries to catch another player.
questions.discussion: Blindfold tag includes a blindfold. A player tries to catch or tag another player while unable to see clearly.

questions.text: What is the English expression for "permainan kejar-kejaran untuk menyentuh pemain lain"?
questions.discussion: Tag is a chasing game. A player tries to touch another player.

questions.text: Complete the sentence: In ___, one player tries to touch another player.
questions.discussion: Tag is a chasing game. A player tries to touch another player.

questions.text:
Read the clue: All players keep their eyes uncovered. One player runs after the others and tries to touch one of them gently.

Which sentence names and describes this chasing game?
options: We draw a hopscotch court before playing.
In tag, one player chases and tries to touch another player.
In jump rope, one or more players jump over a swinging rope.
In blindfold tag, one player wears a blindfold and tries to catch another player.
questions.answer: In tag, one player chases and tries to touch another player.
questions.discussion: Chasing and touching another player with the eyes uncovered describes tag. The clue does not describe blindfold tag, which uses a blindfold.

questions.text: Which game is played by chasing and gently touching another player?
questions.discussion: Tag is a chasing game in which a player tries to touch another player. Play gently and keep a safe distance from obstacles.

questions.text:
Your eyes are uncovered as you chase a friend and gently touch their shoulder.

Which sentence names and describes this game?
options: We draw a hopscotch court before playing.
In tag, one player chases and tries to touch another player.
In blindfold tag, one player wears a blindfold and tries to catch another player.
In jump rope, one or more players jump over a swinging rope.
questions.answer: In tag, one player chases and tries to touch another player.
questions.discussion: The player chases and gently touches a friend without wearing a blindfold. That describes tag.

questions.text: What is the English expression for "melompat"?
questions.discussion: Jump means melompat. It describes moving upward or forward from the ground.

questions.text: Complete the sentence: Please ___ over the small line.
questions.discussion: Jump means melompat. It describes moving upward or forward from the ground.

questions.text: Look at the action-word chart. Which sentence explains the word on the left?
options: In blindfold tag, one player wears a blindfold and tries to catch another player.
In jump rope, one or more players jump over a swinging rope.
Jump means to move off the ground using your legs.
In tag, one player chases and tries to touch another player.
questions.answer: Jump means to move off the ground using your legs.
questions.discussion: The word on the left is JUMP. Jump means to push your body off the ground using your legs.

image.alt: An action-word chart with three words across the top and one below

questions.text: You push off with both feet to move over a low rope. Which action word best describes this movement?
questions.discussion: Jump fits the two-foot movement in the clue. Hop specifically refers to jumping on one foot, and jump rope is the name of a game.

questions.text:
The teacher asks you to push off the ground with your legs and land on the other side of a line.

Which sentence explains this movement?
options: In jump rope, one or more players jump over a swinging rope.
In blindfold tag, one player wears a blindfold and tries to catch another player.
Jump means to move off the ground using your legs.
In tag, one player chases and tries to touch another player.
questions.answer: Jump means to move off the ground using your legs.
questions.discussion: Pushing the body off the ground with the legs describes a jump. The clue does not describe a chasing game or the use of a swinging rope.

questions.text: What is the English expression for "meloncat dengan satu kaki"?
questions.discussion: Hop is a small jump, usually on one foot. It is used when playing hopscotch.

questions.text: Complete the sentence: A player can ___ on one foot in hopscotch.
questions.discussion: Hop is a small jump, usually on one foot. It is used when playing hopscotch.

questions.text:
Read the clue: A player moves forward by jumping on one foot.

Which sentence explains that movement?
options: We play hide and seek after school.
We draw a hopscotch court before playing.
Hop means to move by jumping on one foot.
In jump rope, one or more players jump over a swinging rope.
questions.answer: Hop means to move by jumping on one foot.
questions.discussion: Jumping on one foot is called hopping. The sentence about hop matches the movement in the clue.

questions.text: In hopscotch, what do you do from one square to the next?
questions.discussion: Hop means to jump on one foot. This movement is used in hopscotch.

questions.text: You move forward by jumping on one foot. Which sentence specifically defines this one-foot movement?
options: In blindfold tag, one player wears a blindfold and tries to catch another player.
In tag, one player chases and tries to touch another player.
Hop means to move by jumping on one foot.
Jump means to move off the ground using your legs.
questions.answer: Hop means to move by jumping on one foot.
questions.discussion: Hop specifically means jumping on one foot. Jump is a more general movement, while the clue asks for the specific one-foot action.

questions.text: What is the English expression for "mengayunkan"?
questions.discussion: Swing means to move something back and forth. In jump rope, two players swing the rope.

questions.text:
Look at the action-word chart. Use the word on the right to complete the sentence.

Two children ___ the rope for their friend.
questions.discussion: The word on the right of the chart is SWING. The complete sentence is 'Two children swing the rope for their friend.'

image.alt: An action-word chart with three words across the top and one below

questions.text:
Read the clue: Two children hold the ends of a rope and move it back and forth for another player.

Which sentence describes the action of the two children holding the rope?
options: We draw a hopscotch court before playing.
In jump rope, one or more players jump over a swinging rope.
The children swing the rope for the player.
In blindfold tag, one player wears a blindfold and tries to catch another player.
questions.answer: The children swing the rope for the player.
questions.discussion: The two children holding the ends move the rope, so the sentence about swinging the rope matches their action. The question asks about the helpers, not the jumping player.

questions.text: In a game of jump rope, two children hold the ends of a rope and move it back and forth for a friend. Which verb describes what they do to the rope?
questions.discussion: Swing describes moving the rope back and forth while holding its ends. The clue is about moving the rope, not throwing it away.

questions.text: Your friends move a rope back and forth for you. Which sentence describes their action?
options: Hop means to move by jumping on one foot.
In tag, one player chases and tries to touch another player.
Jump means to move off the ground using your legs.
The children swing the rope for the player.
questions.answer: The children swing the rope for the player.
questions.discussion: Swing means to move something back and forth. Friends swing the rope in jump rope.

questions.text: What is the English expression for "melempar"?
questions.discussion: Throw means melempar. In hopscotch, a token is thrown onto a square.

questions.text: Complete the sentence: First, ___ the token onto a hopscotch square.
questions.discussion: Throw means melempar. In hopscotch, a token is thrown onto a square.

questions.text:
Read the situation: You are about to start hopscotch. The court is ready, and you need to send the token onto a square before hopping.

Which sentence gives that instruction?
options: In jump rope, one or more players jump over a swinging rope.
In tag, one player chases and tries to touch another player.
In blindfold tag, one player wears a blindfold and tries to catch another player.
First, throw the token onto a square.
questions.answer: First, throw the token onto a square.
questions.discussion: The court is ready, so the next action described in the situation is throwing the token onto a square. 'First, throw the token onto a square' gives that instruction.

questions.text: What do you do to the token before hopping in hopscotch?
questions.discussion: Throw means to send something through the air using your hand. In hopscotch, players throw a token onto a square.

questions.text: You are about to send a token onto a square. Which sentence gives the instruction?
options: We play hide and seek after school.
We draw a hopscotch court before playing.
In jump rope, one or more players jump over a swinging rope.
First, throw the token onto a square.
questions.answer: First, throw the token onto a square.
questions.discussion: Throw means to send something through the air using your hand. In hopscotch, players throw a token onto a square.

questions.text: What is the English expression for "pertama"?
questions.discussion: First introduces the beginning of a sequence. It tells us which step comes at the start.

questions.text:
Choose the word meaning 'pertama' to begin these instructions:

___, draw the hopscotch court. Next, throw the token.
questions.discussion: The word first means pertama and introduces step one. At the beginning of the completed sentence, write it with a capital letter: 'First, draw the hopscotch court.'

questions.text: You want to begin a set of hopscotch instructions. Which sentence uses a sequencing word and directly tells the player what to do first?
options: In jump rope, one or more players jump over a swinging rope.
We play hide and seek after school.
We draw a hopscotch court before playing.
questions.discussion: 'First, draw the hopscotch court' uses the sequencing word First and gives a direct instruction with draw.

questions.text: Which word introduces step number one?
questions.discussion: First is a sequencing word used to introduce the beginning of instructions.

questions.text: You are explaining step one of hopscotch. Which sentence begins with a sequencing word and gives a direct instruction?
options: We draw a hopscotch court before playing.
In jump rope, one or more players jump over a swinging rope.
In blindfold tag, one player wears a blindfold and tries to catch another player.
questions.discussion: 'First, draw the hopscotch court' begins with First and tells the listener directly what to do. 'We draw...' describes an action but does not give a direct instruction.
